Support/Frames

Frames

Support

Help with thinking frameworks, saved notes, and PDF worksheets.

SupportPrivacy policyApp details ↗

Availability

Frames is currently in App Store review. A release date has not been announced. These guides describe the submitted version.

Start with a framework or example

Choose a framework from the catalog and open its worked example, or create a blank note. Add thoughts using the prompts and record your key insights and next steps.

Saving your notes

Notes are saved on your device. No account is required. Device-to-device synchronization is not included. Export important notes before removing the app.

Exporting a PDF

Open a note and choose the share button, then the PDF export option. A note and its summary fit onto one A4 page; dense notes use smaller text. You can also export a blank worksheet from a framework’s detail screen.

Working offline

Core note features and bundled translations work offline. Reference links and destinations you choose when sharing may use external services.

Contact support
